# GENERATED by tools/gen_company_decisions.py - edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Stock market model: docs/corporations.md.

tsin_found_company_steel_effect = {
	ordered_owned_location = {
		order_by = tsin_location_company_levels_steel
		max = 1
		save_temporary_scope_as = tsin_company_hq
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:tsin_company_hq }
		set_variable = { name = tsin_hq_steel value = scope:tsin_company_hq }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tsin_stock_steel value = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { tsin_exchange_can_open_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = tsin_has_stock_market
	}
	tsin_capital_cache_effect = yes
}

tsin_update_stock_steel_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_steel has_variable = tsin_stock_steel }
		set_variable = { name = tsin_stock_up value = 0.5 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = capital
				capital.market = { "market_price(goods:steel)" > { value = "default_price(goods:steel)" multiply = 1.3 } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tsin_stock_up value = 0.7 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = capital
				capital.market = { "market_price(goods:steel)" > { value = "default_price(goods:steel)" multiply = 1.1 } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tsin_stock_up value = 0.6 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = capital
				capital.market = { "market_price(goods:steel)" < { value = "default_price(goods:steel)" multiply = 0.7 } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tsin_stock_up value = 0.3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = capital
				capital.market = { "market_price(goods:steel)" < { value = "default_price(goods:steel)" multiply = 0.9 } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tsin_stock_up value = 0.4 }
		}
		tsin_stock_random_walk_effect = { STOCK = tsin_stock_steel }
	}
}

# Quarterly: every company stock, then the national index and its history.
tsin_update_stocks_effect = {
	tsin_update_stock_steel_effect = yes
	tsin_update_stock_machinery_effect = yes
	tsin_update_stock_textile_effect = yes
	tsin_update_stock_chemical_effect = yes
	tsin_update_stock_railway_effect = yes
	tsin_update_stock_farm_machinery_effect = yes
	tsin_update_stock_index_effect = yes
}

# Companies founded before the stock market existed (older saves) get their headquarters and stock.
tsin_init_existing_companies_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_steel NOT = { has_variable = tsin_stock_steel } }
		tsin_found_company_steel_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_machinery NOT = { has_variable = tsin_stock_machinery } }
		tsin_found_company_machinery_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_textile NOT = { has_variable = tsin_stock_textile } }
		tsin_found_company_textile_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_chemical NOT = { has_variable = tsin_stock_chemical } }
		tsin_found_company_chemical_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_railway NOT = { has_variable = tsin_stock_railway } }
		tsin_found_company_railway_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_farm_machinery NOT = { has_variable = tsin_stock_farm_machinery } }
		tsin_found_company_farm_machinery_effect = yes
	}
}

# Market-wide shock: every stock times FACTOR, then the index is recomputed.
tsin_scale_stocks_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_stock_steel }
		change_variable = { name = tsin_stock_steel multiply = $FACTOR$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = tsin_stock_steel min = 10 max = 1000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_stock_machinery }
		change_variable = { name = tsin_stock_machinery multiply = $FACTOR$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = tsin_stock_machinery min = 10 max = 1000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_stock_textile }
		change_variable = { name = tsin_stock_textile multiply = $FACTOR$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = tsin_stock_textile min = 10 max = 1000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_stock_chemical }
		change_variable = { name = tsin_stock_chemical multiply = $FACTOR$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = tsin_stock_chemical min = 10 max = 1000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_stock_railway }
		change_variable = { name = tsin_stock_railway multiply = $FACTOR$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = tsin_stock_railway min = 10 max = 1000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_stock_farm_machinery }
		change_variable = { name = tsin_stock_farm_machinery multiply = $FACTOR$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = tsin_stock_farm_machinery min = 10 max = 1000 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_stock_index }
		set_variable = { name = tsin_stock_index value = tsin_stock_index_value }
	}
}

tsin_dissolve_all_companies_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_steel } remove_country_modifier = tsin_company_steel }
	remove_variable = tsin_hq_steel
	remove_variable = tsin_stock_steel
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_machinery } remove_country_modifier = tsin_company_machinery }
	remove_variable = tsin_hq_machinery
	remove_variable = tsin_stock_machinery
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_textile } remove_country_modifier = tsin_company_textile }
	remove_variable = tsin_hq_textile
	remove_variable = tsin_stock_textile
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_chemical } remove_country_modifier = tsin_company_chemical }
	remove_variable = tsin_hq_chemical
	remove_variable = tsin_stock_chemical
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_railway } remove_country_modifier = tsin_company_railway }
	remove_variable = tsin_hq_railway
	remove_variable = tsin_stock_railway
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_farm_machinery } remove_country_modifier = tsin_company_farm_machinery }
	remove_variable = tsin_hq_farm_machinery
	remove_variable = tsin_stock_farm_machinery
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_charter_colonial }
		remove_variable = tsin_charter_colonial
		remove_country_modifier = tsin_charter_colonial_company
	}
	tsin_revoke_company_charters_effect = yes
	remove_variable = tsin_has_stock_market
	remove_variable = tsin_stock_index
	remove_variable = tsin_chairman
	remove_variable = tsin_index_h0
	remove_variable = tsin_index_h1
	remove_variable = tsin_index_h2
	remove_variable = tsin_index_h3
	remove_variable = tsin_index_h4
	remove_variable = tsin_index_h5
	remove_variable = tsin_index_h6
	remove_variable = tsin_index_h7
}

# Shifts the index history h0 (newest) .. h7 (oldest).
tsin_shift_stock_history_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_index_h6 }
		set_variable = { name = tsin_index_h7 value = var:tsin_index_h6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_index_h5 }
		set_variable = { name = tsin_index_h6 value = var:tsin_index_h5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_index_h4 }
		set_variable = { name = tsin_index_h5 value = var:tsin_index_h4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_index_h3 }
		set_variable = { name = tsin_index_h4 value = var:tsin_index_h3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_index_h2 }
		set_variable = { name = tsin_index_h3 value = var:tsin_index_h2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_index_h1 }
		set_variable = { name = tsin_index_h2 value = var:tsin_index_h1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tsin_index_h0 }
		set_variable = { name = tsin_index_h1 value = var:tsin_index_h0 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tsin_index_h0 value = var:tsin_stock_index }
}
